summary: Same converged review, security lens. Installer identity comes only from host-received provider events (my_chat_member from.id, member_joined_channel inviter) - never message text; recognition is lookup-only (createIfMissing:false) so ID-1's DM-only person minting is untouched, and requires an established direct conversation (aliases alone auto-mint for group speakers). Unrecognised, retired-alias, and missing-inviter cases all fail closed. The seed goes through the settings write (authority) and grants nothing beyond approver status (PERM-2 intact). Reclaim fencing prevents a stale claimant from seeding its installer over a later installation.
residual_risks: Auto-registration on recognition replaces the DM-approver confirmation gate by design (0119 amendment, confirmed by Ravi): any DM-established person can register the bot into a group they add it to.
